QUOTE: Enable `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` and define both `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO`... Stack/heap buffer allocator. `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` serves allocations from a caller-supplied buffer and never calls libc.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer never says the buffer allocator (MBEDTLS_MEMORY_BUFFER_ALLOC_C) itself requires MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY. It only says that `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init` calls the setter.
